notes.title: Character Controlls update
notes.content:
- use both rockets helps stabilise the player
- the overall difficulty of steering starts lower and increases towards the end

notes.title: small bug fixes
notes.content:
- fixed bug where a restet at the start of the game lets you skip the first floor
- fixed bug where you get stuck at the rotation enemy by removing its length

notes.title: bugfix
notes.content: fixed a bug where the timer resets on save and load

notes.title: Easy Mode and Cheat support
notes.content:
For those who dont have honor and need an easy mode, there is now the possibility.

Added a [i]nice[/i] single cheatcode, good luck finding it.

notes.title: minor bugfixes
notes.content:
bugfix: 
- can now use arrow keys to navigate menu
- store language settings
- controlls panel get deactivated if you reopen the menu and had it open before

notes.title: small Fixes
notes.content:
- added 1 missing sound effect
- made the last level "finishable" ( was almost impossible )
